parameters: \c[1]The Avatar of Donar's army is victorious today. The catastrophe has been avoided, the brood continuity of my kin is protected.
Those boys were no joke. I've never seen the Archaelus armies fight with such fervor. What gives, dragon?

\c[1]Brief is the timeline of a human's life. Not brief is mine. Also not brief is the timeline of the forces arrayed against the Avatar of Donar.\! Ageless, is the dark one. The one not of the essence of Tahnra's creation.

\c[1]The one not of Tahnra bears an understanding beyond that which is possible within one mere timeline of the human.\! This empire named Archaelus, this army named Nephilim Army. Brief contrivances these are, to the dark one.\! To him, the mission is one that spans millennia. As long as his life. As my life.
Yeah, I think that's pretty clear at this point. So, what exactly is this mission of his, anyway? The one I keep getting told I couldn't possibly understand?
Dear Azuros, please trust \n[8] with your wisdom!

\c[1]Adorimetra, the Gold. Mother of all of my kin. Mother of Azuros.\! First born of Donar in all Tahnra. First to awaken, when the god of creation awakened this world.\! Just as the Avatar of Donar stands before Azuros, so too does Azuros live.\! The dark one is not a descendant of Adorimetra. Not a descendant of Donar. An infestation.\! The mission of the human's timeline is to destroy, or to impede Zanatus.\! To destroy his body, and followers, and most crucially, his words. Words he has infused within the language of the mortal beings of Tahnra. Words which will be the undoing of all things.\! Words whose nature lie beyond even the understanding of Azuros...

An infestation. Interesting choice of words, Azuros. Everything else has been about some overwhelming power of creation.\! You, me, Abigayle, the magic that brought me back... all living things, all elements of nature, even Casamir, perhaps. But the one outlier is Zanatus.\! Any insight into what exactly he is, then?
I'm sorry, \n[8], this is all Dear Azuros knows. I feel a great regret within him. There is very little he doesn't know, thus the nature of Zanatus frustrates him greatly!

\c[1]The one named "Nibbler" has found counsel in me. He cares for Abigayle greatly. The young dragon's request will be fulfilled.\! In times ancient, there was one called "Queen of Dragons". This title will now return to Tahnra.\! Queen of Dragons Abigayle. The power of dragonkind is now yours to wield.
It's a little on the nose if you ask me, but hey, might as well make it official.
\c[1]Abigayle can now become the "Queen of Dragons" unit, an incredibly powerful new type of Dragon Rider. Access this new class in the Class Change menu.

note: Meeting between Abi, Azuros, and Protag. Azuros teaches them about nature of fey magic. Azuros invites Abi to become his rider from then on
